title: Corporate Pension Risk-Taking in a Low Interest Rate Environment
authors: Vasso P. Ioannidou; Roberto Pinto; Zexi Wang
eligible_reason: Single common event date: the MAP-21 funding-relief reform of 2012. StataCode/DidBunchersAllAssetClasses.do lines 74-76: after_map21 = (year_form >= 2012) for every plan, inter_map21 = after_map21 x trt_gr (high-relief 'buncher' plans with 80-85% funding status vs. others), 2009-2015, 2012 dropped; reghdfe y inter_map21, a(year_form#naics3 firm_plan). The dynamic DiD (Figures 6-7, inter_pre_k/inter_post_k) is around the same date. One adoption cohort, so not staggered. Other tables are continuous-regressor panels (fund_status, fedfunds), RD-style plots and cross-sectional splits with extra post x characteristic terms.
design_notes: Stata reghdfe. Plan-level panel (firm_plan = ein x plan_pn), year_form 2009-2015; FE year_form#naics3 and firm_plan; cluster firm_plan. Tables 6-9, A4-A6, IA1 and Figures 6-8, A2, IA2-IA3 all use the same 2012 post indicator.
data_files_note: The plan-level Form 5500 panels (DbMainFormSchBAndSchR_20092019.dta etc.) are not in the archive; they must be rebuilt from public DOL / Boston College downloads with the builder code. Compustat is proprietary. Only sponsor-name crosswalks and Fed funds series are shipped.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text). MAP-21 (2012) single-date DiD on high- vs low-relief plans.
